title: Training and Benchmarking Code Generation for Physics-Inspired Animations
abstract: arXiv:2602.10840v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have been widely studied in areas such as mathematical reasoning, complex coding, and scientific problem solving. However, their ability to generate executable code that visually depicts physical scenarios and their qualitative dynamics remains underexplored. We propose SimuScene, the first systematic study that trains and evaluates LLMs on code generation for physics-inspired animations across 52 concepts spanning five physics domains. We build an automated data collection pipeline with human verification to ensure data quality. The resulting dataset contains 7,659 scenarios, including a 334-example human-verified test set. We evaluate 10 contemporary LLMs and find that even the strongest model achieves only a 21.5\% Avg@8 accuracy, demonstrating the difficulty of generating animations that are both executable and visually aligned with physical scenario descriptions. translated_title: 物理启发动画的代码生成训练与基准测试
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）已在数学推理、复杂编码和科学问题解决等领域得到广泛研究。然而，它们生成可执行代码以视觉化描绘物理场景及其定性动态的能力仍未得到充分探索。我们提出了SimuScene，这是首个系统性研究，旨在训练和评估LLMs在跨五个物理领域52个概念的物理启发动画代码生成任务上的表现。我们构建了一个自动化数据收集管道，并辅以人工验证以确保数据质量。最终数据集包含7,659个场景，其中包括一个由334个示例组成的人工验证测试集。我们评估了10个当代LLMs，发现即使最强的模型也仅达到21.5%的Avg@8准确率，这表明生成既可执行又与物理场景描述视觉对齐的动画具有很大难度。最后，我们引入了一种强化学习方法。
tldr: 该论文首次系统性地训练和评估大型语言模型生成物理启发动画代码，并构建了包含7,659个场景的数据集，发现现有最强模型准确率仅21.5%，凸显了这一任务的挑战性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic study training and evaluating LLMs for physics-inspired animation code generation, with a dataset of 7,659 scenarios, showing that even the strongest model achieves only 21.5% accuracy, highlighting the task's difficulty.
